rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Fake OTA Domain Pattern Detection — DL-0180")`
`comment("Detects access to recently registered domains mimicking major OTA brands")`
index=flame_proxy sourcetype=flame:web_traffic
| rex field=request_domain "(?i)(?<brand_match>book[1i!l]ng|b00king|exped[1i!l]a|exp3dia|a[1i!l]rbnb|airbnb)"
| where isnotnull(brand_match)
| lookup domain_whois_enrichment request_domain OUTPUT domain_registration_date, domain_age_days
| where domain_age_days < 30
| eval is_payment_page = if(match(request_url, "(?i)(payment|checkout|pay|billing|card|credit)"), 1, 0)
| eval risk_score = case(
    is_payment_page=1 AND domain_age_days < 7, "critical",
    is_payment_page=1, "high",
    domain_age_days < 7, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| stats count as request_count,
        dc(source_ip) as unique_visitors,
        values(request_url) as urls,
        max(is_payment_page) as has_payment_page
  by request_domain, domain_registration_date, domain_age_days, risk_score
| sort - request_count
rules.title: DL-0180: Fake OTA Domain Pattern Detection — Domains Mimicking Booking.com/Expedia/Airbnb Registered < 30 Days (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for B4U Booking Velocity Anomaly — DL-0181")`
`comment("Detects same payment method booking across multiple OTAs/hotels in rapid succession")`
index=flame_payments sourcetype=flame:travel_bookings
  (transaction_type="travel_booking" OR transaction_type="hotel_reservation"
   OR transaction_type="flight_purchase" OR transaction_type="car_rental")
| bin _time span=24h
| stats dc(merchant_name) as unique_merchants,
        dc(traveler_name) as unique_travelers,
        dc(destination_city) as unique_destinations,
        count as booking_count,
        sum(transaction_amount) as total_amount,
        values(traveler_name) as traveler_names,
        values(merchant_name) as merchants,
        values(destination_city) as destinations
  by payment_method_hash, _time
| where booking_count >= 3 AND unique_merchants >= 2
| eval risk_score = case(
    booking_count >= 6 AND unique_merchants >= 4 AND unique_travelers >= 3, "critical",
    booking_count >= 4 AND unique_merchants >= 3 AND unique_travelers >= 2, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| eval traveler_count = mvcount(traveler_names)
| where traveler_count >= 2
| table payment_method_hash, _time, booking_count, unique_merchants,
        unique_travelers, unique_destinations, total_amount,
        traveler_names, merchants, destinations, risk_score
| sort - booking_count
rules.title: DL-0181: B4U Booking Velocity Anomaly — Same Payment Method Booking Across Multiple OTAs/Hotels in Rapid Succession (SPLUNK)
